subject: Connecting two Krabbe-focused patient communities
body:
Dear Krabbe UK team,

My name is Maria, and I lead a patient group supporting families affected by Krabbe disease. I'm reaching out because I believe our communities share a common focus.

Given that our organisations both work closely with families navigating this same rare condition, I thought it could be valuable for us to connect and learn more about each other's work.

Would you be open to a brief introductory call in the coming weeks? Nothing formal at this stage—just an opportunity to share experiences and explore whether there might be useful ways to support one another going forward.

Thank you for the work you do for families affected by Krabbe. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Maria
Patient Group Leader
